title: TOEFL & IELTS Prep
intro:
📌 Tentang kursus ini
Persiapan TOEFL ITP/iBT dan IELTS Academic untuk siswa SMA dan mahasiswa. Setiap unit membahas strategi menjawab beserta latihan bergaya soal asli. Gunakan Tutor AI untuk melatih IELTS Speaking.

sections.html: Bagian Structure & Written Expression pada TOEFL ITP berisi 40 soal dalam 25 menit, jadi kira-kira 37 detik per soal. Kuncinya adalah mengenali pola, bukan menerjemahkan seluruh kalimat.

sections.title: Passage: Coral bleaching
paras:
Why Corals Turn White
Coral reefs cover less than one percent of the ocean floor, yet they support about a quarter of all marine species. Their bright colours come from tiny algae called zooxanthellae, which live inside the coral's tissues and provide it with food through photosynthesis.

When ocean temperatures rise even one or two degrees above normal for several weeks, corals become stressed and expel these algae. Without them, the coral's white skeleton becomes visible, a process known as bleaching. Bleached corals are not dead, but they are starving; if the water cools quickly, the algae can return. Prolonged heat, however, often leads to widespread coral death.

Scientists are now testing ways to help reefs survive, such as breeding heat-tolerant corals and shading small reef areas. Most researchers agree, though, that these methods can only buy time unless global warming itself is slowed.

sections.instr: Answer the questions about the passage.
items: What is the passage mainly about?|the history of coral reefs|the causes and effects of coral bleaching|how algae perform photosynthesis|marine species in Australia
According to the passage, where do corals get their colour?|from their skeletons|from warm water|from algae living in their tissues|from sunlight
The word "expel" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to ...|absorb|push out|protect|feed
The word "they" in "they are starving" refers to ...|algae|bleached corals|scientists|temperatures

It can be inferred from the last paragraph that researchers believe ...|reef problems are already solved|shading all reefs is easy|reducing global warming is essential|heat-tolerant corals are useless

sections.html: Untuk soal vocabulary in context, jangan langsung memilih arti kata yang paling umum. Masukkan pilihan jawaban ke dalam kalimat, lalu pilih yang tidak mengubah makna.

goals: Memahami percakapan pendek beserta idiom dan saran yang tersirat.
Mengenali jebakan kata yang bunyinya mirip.

sections.html: Pada TOEFL ITP Listening Part A, kamu mendengar percakapan pendek, lalu pertanyaan "What does the man mean?". Jawaban yang benar biasanya memparafrasekan kalimat terakhir dan jarang memakai kata yang sama persis. Hindari pilihan yang memuat kata yang bunyinya mirip dengan kata dalam rekaman.
sections.title: Pola soal
Short conversation 1
lines: Woman
I can't believe how hard the chemistry exam was.
Aku tak percaya ujian kimianya sesulit itu.
Man
Tell me about it! I could hardly finish half of it.
Betul sekali! Aku hampir tak bisa menyelesaikan separuhnya.

sections.title: Short conversation 2
lines: Man
Should I take the bus to the conference center?
Apakah aku sebaiknya naik bus ke gedung konferensi?
Woman
If I were you, I'd take a taxi. The bus takes forever at this hour.
Kalau aku jadi kamu, aku naik taksi. Bus jam segini lama sekali.

sections.title: Short conversation 3
lines: Woman
Did you finish the reading assignment for Professor Lee?
Sudah selesai tugas membaca dari Profesor Lee?
Man
I haven't even started. I'll have to burn the midnight oil tonight.
Belum mulai sama sekali. Aku harus begadang malam ini.

sections.instr: What does the second speaker mean?
items: Conversation 1 — What does the man mean?|He found the exam easy.|He also found the exam very difficult.|He wants to talk about chemistry.|He finished the exam early.
Conversation 2 — What does the woman suggest?|waiting for the bus|walking to the center|taking a taxi|skipping the conference
Conversation 3 — What will the man probably do?|study late tonight|buy some oil|ask the professor for help|go to bed early

sections.title: Model introduction
paras: Question: Some people think that children should learn a foreign language at primary school. Others believe it is better to start at secondary school. Discuss both views and give your opinion.

It is often debated whether children should begin studying a foreign language at primary or secondary school. While some argue that older learners are more focused, I believe that starting early offers greater benefits, particularly for pronunciation and confidence.

items: Online learning is flexible. ___, it requires strong self-discipline.|Therefore|However|For example|Moreover
Air pollution has increased. ___, more people suffer from asthma.|As a result|Nevertheless|Whereas|For instance
Public transport reduces traffic. ___, it lowers carbon emissions.|However|In conclusion|Furthermore|Whereas
Many cities, ___ Singapore and Seoul, have efficient metro systems.|such as|therefore|however|moreover
Which sentence is the best thesis statement?|Technology is a thing.|This essay will argue that technology improves education when used wisely.|I like computers very much.|There are many opinions.

sections.title: Part 1 sample
lines: Examiner
Do you prefer studying in the morning or in the evening?
Kamu lebih suka belajar pagi atau malam?
Candidate
I'd say the morning, to be honest. My mind is much fresher after a good night's sleep, so I can concentrate better. For example, I usually review vocabulary right after breakfast.
Pagi, jujur saja. Pikiran saya lebih segar setelah tidur nyenyak, jadi bisa lebih fokus. Misalnya, saya biasa mengulang kosakata setelah sarapan.
Examiner
Why do you think some people prefer studying at night?
Menurutmu kenapa sebagian orang lebih suka belajar malam?
Candidate
It depends on their lifestyle. Some students work during the day, whereas others simply find the night quieter and have fewer distractions.
Tergantung gaya hidupnya. Ada yang bekerja di siang hari, ada juga yang merasa malam lebih tenang dan minim gangguan.
